description: 24 small, authored requests across extraction, classification, summarization, and reasoning. Expected answers are checked by normalized exact match. This dataset is an engineering smoke benchmark, not representative production traffic.

Classify sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative: I love the faster checkout.
Classify sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative: The item arrived broken and support did not reply.
Classify sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative: The parcel arrived on Tuesday.
Choose billing, delivery, or account: I was charged twice for one order.
Choose billing, delivery, or account: I cannot reset my password.
Choose billing, delivery, or account: Tracking says my package is delayed.
